title: Anki Review
done: No more cards to review in this session.
empty: No decks available. Open an Anki profile and reload.
media: Open this card in Anki to see its full content.
error.addon_missing: AnkiConnect was not found in the default Anki folder. In Anki Desktop, use Tools → Add-ons → Get Add-ons and enter 2055492159. Restart Anki once after installing, then reload decks.
error.connection: AnkiConnect is unreachable at 127.0.0.1:8765. Check that the add-on is enabled in Anki Desktop, then reload decks.
error.api: AnkiConnect rejected the request. Check the add-on and Anki Desktop.
error.deck: Anki could not start a review for this deck.
error.changed: The active card changed in Anki. Start the deck again.
error.grade: Check Anki Desktop to see whether the grade was saved before continuing.
error.anki_missing: Anki Desktop could not be found. Install Anki and reload.
error.anki_running: Anki is already running. Check that AnkiConnect is enabled, then reload.
error.launch_pending: Anki is already starting. Wait a moment and reload.
error.launch_failed: Hyprland could not launch Anki. Open Anki from the app launcher.
error.launch_timeout: AnkiConnect did not respond after launch. Open the Anki workspace to check for a prompt.
